value.rationale: The exact finite-versus-diverging VaR obstruction invalidates a reported approximation in precisely the high-confidence regime where it is presented as useful. At a valid parameter point a nominal 99% risk threshold delivers only 72.279985% model coverage and is over 33 times smaller than the actual VaR. The result provides a sharp all-parameter coverage envelope and a simple exact numerical remedy; it is not merely a syntax, sign, or insignificant rounding correction.
